video_title: Hornets vs Bucks: Brandon Miller Postgame Media Availability | 10/11/2026

quotes.speaker: Brandon Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Miller on his comfort level and team trust
quotes.excerpt: the team trust me to go out there and perform the way I do
quotes.quote: I would just say the comfortability, just finding what I like to do. The team trust me to go out there and perform the way I do. But I think just being comfortable out there while I am playing hard as I can, giving 110% effort every possession down and just making all the winning plays. I think that is kind of a confidence booster and I think that goes a long way in a basketball game.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Miller says his confidence is growing as he finds his comfort level on the floor, noting that the team trust is a major factor in his performance.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Miller on playing in a two-man game with Naz Reid
quotes.excerpt: we hit him in the post a lot, usually more than likely most teams won't help off of me
quotes.quote: A lot of different sources to go to with me and Naz. I feel like we hit him in the post a lot, usually more than likely most teams won't help off of me, so it kind of gives him an advantage just to go one-on-one. We believe in Naz to go one-on-one on smaller guards like that. So just having that advantage and that connection with him is always great for us as an organization.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Miller on the two-man game with Naz Reid: We believe in Naz to go one-on-one on smaller guards. Having that connection is a major advantage for our organization.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Miller on the team's fast-paced offensive execution
quotes.excerpt: when we play fast it makes teams switch up their coverages more than likely other times
quotes.quote: I think just playing to our strengths. Obviously we are going to play fast with the kick-aheads of course. I think we executed that at a high clip tonight. I think when we play fast it makes teams switch up their coverages more than likely other times. So just having that option to play fast and then knowing when we can slow down and play half-court game is always an advantage for us.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Miller says the Hornets are focused on playing fast to force teams to switch up their coverages, but they are also learning when to slow down and execute in the half-court.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Miller on Scoot Henderson's growth as a point guard
quotes.excerpt: he guards everybody's best player, great defender, great full-court defender
quotes.quote: As a point guard now we trust him just to bring the ball up the court. But I think he does more than that. I think he guards everybody's best player, great defender, great full-court defender. But not even just that, he is a young leader which goes a long way in the NBA. Just leading vocally, I think for him it is just his preparation every day is going to be a big standout for him.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Miller praised Scoot Henderson for his growth as a leader, noting that he is a great full-court defender who is stepping up as a vocal leader for the team.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Miller on the team's chemistry with new additions
quotes.excerpt: having guys like Grayson, Royse, Lee, people that has been around before, it helps us as young guys
quotes.quote: The connection is there. We have been together since the summer, building these bonds since day one. Just having guys like Grayson Allen, Royse O'Neal, Lee McGinley, people that has been around before or has been in that playoff era that we want to be in, I think they help us as young guys just to prepare us for the playoff type of games, the away games that are pretty loud. So just having guys like that is a win for us.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Miller credits veterans like Grayson Allen and Royce O'Neal for helping the young Hornets prepare for the intensity of playoff-style games.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Miller on Royse O'Neal's shooting and veteran presence
quotes.excerpt: he is more of a better shooter than me on the three-point line
quotes.quote: I think he is more of a better shooter than me on the three-point line, so I am going to give him that one. But he is always a willing passer, he plays the game the right way. So having a 10, 12-year vet like him around us is always great for us because he knows, he has been through the game, he knows what it takes to get to where we want to be.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Miller on Royce O'Neal: He is a willing passer who plays the game the right way. Having a 10 to 12 year vet around is great for us because he knows what it takes to get where we want to be.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Miller on exploiting mismatches and spacing
quotes.excerpt: having that kind of space is going to give me more room to work
quotes.quote: Taking advantage of smaller defenders, slower defenders. I think having that kind of space is going to give me more room to work. Of course, I also have a lot of shooters around the perimeter, so if they help, it is a quick pass, quick three. So it is always a win if it is helping me.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Miller says the team is focused on exploiting mismatches against smaller or slower defenders, noting that the spacing provided by their shooters makes the offense difficult to guard.
